correctness.rationale: Fernandes–Paulista dihedral extension lemma plus the forbidden-whole-cycle criterion yield the rotation/reflection generating functions. All extension duplications are independently accounted for at ranks zero, one, and antipodal rank two, with no duplications at higher ranks; the primitive-rotation argument counts top rank n−1; a logarithmic order cutoff proves the uniform half-density error. Exact independent enumerations agree for all n=3..10. No finite check is used as an infinite proof.
